kurz: A good pizza needs a stretchy, flavourful dough and an oven as hot as possible.
bild_im_kopf: A balloon that puffs up and sets in seconds.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Prove the dough long and cool
Let it come to temperature and rest before stretching
Stretch by hand, do not flatten the rim
schluesselmomente.warum: The gas bubbles in the rim make the airy cornicione.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Bake as hot as possible on a preheated stone or steel
schluesselmomente.warum: Strong heat from below gives [[ofentrieb|oven spring]] and crust before the topping dries out.
